These survey cut-/sut- hammer responses retain the attested family and ordinary suffixes. The article also compares Marathi sutkī; this external comparison is retained as a caveat and does not establish an immediate donor for these forms. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
